title: C1 Milestone 3: Review Test
completion_message: ¡Extraordinario! Has superado el Milestone 3 del Nivel C1. Manejas la inversión condicional formal, la pasiva impersonal avanzada y un vocabulario de clase mundial en macroeconomía y comunicación de crisis. ¡Estás a nivel ejecutivo C-suite!

parts.visual:
En este hito repasaremos las lecciones 11 a 14 del nivel C1: 
- Inversion in Conditionals (Should you need... / Had I known... / Were we to invest...). 
- Advanced Passives (It is reported that... / The CEO is believed to be resigning...).
parts.audio: In this milestone we will review lessons 11 to 14 of the C1 level. We will test your ability to use Inversion in Conditionals, such as 'Should you need', 'Had I known', or 'Were we to invest'. We will also review Advanced Passives like 'It is reported that' or 'The CEO is believed to be resigning'.

parts.visual:
También evaluaremos vocabulario avanzado de:
- Global Economics & Trade (GDP, inflation, tariff, supply chain, subsidy, recession, exchange rate). 
- PR & Crisis Management (Damage control, backlash, scapegoat, whistleblower, spin, press release). 
¡Este es el examen más sofisticado del nivel C1 hasta ahora!
parts.audio: We will also evaluate advanced vocabulary from Global Economics and Trade, including terms like G D P, inflation, tariff, supply chain, subsidy, recession, and exchange rate. And from P R and Crisis Management: damage control, backlash, scapegoat, whistleblower, spin, and press release. This is the most sophisticated test of the C1 level so far!

stages.title: Milestone Quiz
stages.description: Elige la respuesta correcta en este examen de alto nivel C1.

questions.question: Normal: If you have any queries, email us. -> ____ you have any queries, email us. (Inversión formal).
questions.explanation: Should you have... = First Conditional Inversion.

questions.question: People say that inflation is at a record high. -> ____ is said that inflation is at a record high. (Pasiva impersonal).
questions.explanation: Impersonal passive: It is said that...

questions.question: The GDP of the country fell by 2% last quarter, signaling a potential ____. (Recesión).
After the scandal, the PR team launched a massive ____ campaign to protect the brand. (Control de daños).
Normal: If I had been warned, I would have left. -> ____ I been warned, I would have left. (Inversión 3rd Conditional).
questions.explanation: Had I been warned... = Third Conditional Inversion.

questions.question: Analysts report that the merger has failed. -> The merger is reported ____ failed. (Pasiva avanzada).
The government imposed heavy ____ on imported cars to protect local manufacturers. (Aranceles).
The junior accountant was made the ____ for the entire financial fraud. (Chivo expiatorio).
Normal: If the CEO resigned, the stock would fall. -> ____ the CEO to resign, the stock would fall. (2nd Conditional).
questions.explanation: Were the CEO to resign... = Second Conditional Inversion.

questions.question: Experts believe that the economy will contract. -> ____ is believed that the economy will contract. (Pasiva).
questions.explanation: Impersonal passive: It is believed that...

questions.question: The COVID-19 pandemic severely disrupted the global ____ chain. (Cadena de suministro).
A ____ who leaked internal documents exposed the company's illegal practices. (Informante).
____ you find the information useful, please share it with your colleagues. (En caso de que).
questions.explanation: Should you find... = First Conditional Inversion.

questions.question: The CEO is thought ____ a personal fortune of $500 million. (Tener - Advanced Passive).
The central bank raised ____ rates to slow down inflation. (Tasas de interés).
The company issued an official press ____ addressing the allegations. (Comunicado de prensa).
____ I not taken that risk, we would never have succeeded. (Si no hubiera tomado - 3rd Conditional).
questions.explanation: Had I not taken... = Third Conditional Inversion.

questions.question: The government announced a large financial ____ for the struggling car industry. (Subsidio).
The spokesperson tried to ____ the data to make the results look more positive. (Sesgar favorablemente).
The economy is expected ____ by 4% this fiscal year. (Crecer - Advanced Passive).
questions.explanation: ...is expected to grow (future action, simple infinitive).

stages.title: Written Expression
stages.description: Escribe la palabra clave de este bloque C1.

questions.question: ____ you need help, call us. (Inversión formal con S)
____ I known, I'd have acted. (Inversión 3rd con H)
____ it not for her, we'd have lost. (Inversión Were con W)
____ is said that the company is bankrupt. (Pasiva impersonal con I)
He is believed ____ ____ the money. (Haber robado - 2 palabras)
Trade ____. (Déficit con D)
Import ____. (Arancel con T)
____ control. (Control de daños con D)
The public ____. (Reacción negativa masiva con B)
Press ____. (Comunicado de prensa con R)

pairs.source: She is believed to have left
pairs.target: Se cree que ella se ha ido
